autoContext: Validates searchWeb action. Covers: engine param ('duckduckgo' is real keyless web search against the DDG HTML endpoint and is the default, 'duckduckgo-instant' is the keyless Instant Answer API which only answers definitional queries, 'google' requires apiKey+cx, 'bing' requires apiKey), query param (string with {variable} template), queryKey param (alternative to inline query — reads value from previous_data), maxResults param (int cap on results), missing credentials returns None so the id is popped and the workflow default stands, unknown engine returns None. NOTE: requires internet access.

test_duckduckgo_inline_query._comment: PARAM: engine='duckduckgo' — real web search against html.duckduckgo.com, no credentials needed. This is the default engine, so omitting 'engine' entirely behaves the same way. Results carry title, unwrapped URL and snippet. PARAM: query — inline string with {variable} template resolved from includedData.

test_duckduckgo_querykey._comment: PARAM: queryKey — alternative to inline query. Reads the value of this key from previous_data and uses it as the search query. Takes precedence over query param when both present.

test_duckduckgo_max_results._comment: PARAM: maxResults — int cap on number of results returned. Limits the formatted output length.

test_duckduckgo_instant._comment: PARAM: engine='duckduckgo-instant' — the JSON Instant Answer API, also keyless. It is NOT a web search: it returns an abstract for a definitional query and nothing at all for most others, which is why it is not the default. Kept because it is the cheapest way to get a one-paragraph definition with a source URL. A '[no results for: ...]' string here is a pass, not a failure.

test_google_missing_credentials._comment: PARAM: engine='google' — requires apiKey and cx (Custom Search Engine ID). When either is absent the handler logs 'searchWeb(google): missing apiKey or cx' and returns None, so the id is popped and any workflow default stands. It does NOT fall back to another engine. Workflow continues.

test_bing_missing_credentials._comment: PARAM: engine='bing' — requires apiKey. When absent the handler logs and returns None, same as google. PARAM: apiKey — credential string passed directly in action def, or via {"override": "key_name"} from a secrets loadContext, since searchWeb does no {placeholder} interpolation on credential fields.

test_unknown_engine._comment: PARAM: engine with unrecognised value — handler returns None and prints warning. Workflow continues.
Confirm workflow continues after unknown engine failure.
